Kuvitus: Aurinko ja planeettojen radat v: Illustration: the Sun and the orbits of the planets on the left, the Voyager 2 probe far away in space on the right. Behind the probe, marks of its earlier positions lie evenly spaced on a straight track, one for each equal time step; the next positions continue ahead as a dashed line.
Liikekuva, jossa sama kärry on piirretty: Motion diagram in which the same trolley is drawn at five consecutive seconds on the grid: 0 s, 1 s, 2 s, 3 s and 4 s. The gaps between the trolleys are equal, and under each gap there is an equally long bracket Δs: in uniform motion an object travels equal distances in equal intervals of time. The gaps are drawn to scale, and the trolleys are the same size.
yhtä pitkissä ajoissa yhtä pitkät matkat: equal distances in equal intervals of time
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: kaksi tasaista li: Graph drawn to scale: two uniform motions at a speed of 3 m/s are shown as straight lines in a (t, s) coordinate system. The lower line passes through the origin (initial position 0), and the upper line starts from the position s₀ = 5 m and is parallel to the lower line. A slope triangle is drawn on the lower line: in 2 s the position increases by 6 m, so the slope is 3 m/s, which is the speed.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: kävelijän paikka: Graph drawn to scale: the position s of a walker as a function of time t, a straight line from the origin. The grid spacing is 1 s and 5 m. The line passes through the grid crossings (2 s; 5 m), (4 s; 10 m), (6 s; 15 m), (8 s; 20 m) and (10 s; 25 m).
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: paikka s ajan t f: Graph drawn to scale: the position s as a function of time t. The grid spacing is 1 s and 2 m. The line is horizontal at s = 6 m in the interval 0–4 s and then goes straight down to s = 0 m at the time 10 s.

Graph drawn to scale: the position s as a function of time t. The grid spacing is 1 s and 2 m. The line is horizontal at s = 6 m in the interval 0–4 s and then goes straight up to s = 12 m at the time 10 s.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: kuljettu matka Δs: Graph drawn to scale: the distance walked Δs as a function of time t. The grid spacing is 1 s and 2 m. The line is horizontal at Δs = 0 m in the interval 0–4 s and then goes straight up to Δs = 6 m at the time 10 s.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: nopeus v ajan t f: Graph drawn to scale: the velocity v as a function of time t. The grid spacing is 1 s and 0.25 m/s. The line lies on the t-axis, v = 0, in the interval 0–4 s and is then horizontal at v = 1.0 m/s in the interval 4–10 s.
